name: Lendova
description: Lendova during the Conflict at Mylok IV.]] Lendova was a Habeen Nebulon-B frigate that was involved in a diplomatic mission to bring the Habeen into the Galactic Empire some time during the Galactic Civil War. At the rendezvous with Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin aboard the Imperial Nebulon-B2 frigate Shamus, the Lendova was attacked by the four Nharwaak CR90 Corellian corvettes of Phazer group.
